spans.s:
m. (-षः)
1 Union, junction, the proximity of contact.
2 Association, society, presence.
3 Embracing, an embrace.
4 Adhering or clinging to, &c.
5 A figure of rhetoric, choice or connexion of words so as to admit of a double interpretation, a species of paronomasia or pun.
E.
श्लिष to embrace, aff. ण.

m. (-कः)
Phlegm, the watery or phlegmatic humor.
E.
श्लेष्मन् the same, कन् pleonasm.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Removing phlegm.
f. (-घ्ना)
1 Arabian jasmine.
2 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
f. (-घ्नी)
Hogweed.
E.
श्लेष्म phlegm, and घ्न removing, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीप्.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced or proceeding from phlegm.
E.
श्लेष्मन्, and ज born.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Phlegmatic.
f. (-णा)
A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.)
E.
श्लेष्मन् the humor, and न aff.

m. (-ष्मा)
The phlegmatic humor, one of the three principal humors or fluids of the body.
E.
श्लिष to embrace or adhere to, (the body,) aff. मनिन्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Phlegmatic, abounding or affected with phlegm, &c.
m. (-लः)
A plant, (Cordia latifolia.)
E.
श्लेष्म phlegm, लच् aff.

m. (-हः)
A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal.
E.
श्लेष्म phlegm, and ह destroying.

m. (-तः)
A small tree, (Cordia latifolia.)
E.
श्लेष्मन् phlegm, अत to go, (to remove,) aff. अच्; also with कन् added श्लेष्मातक.
